message: Chest pain or angina symptoms: call 911.
Shortness of breath that does not get better with rest: call 911.
Sudden weakness or numbness in the face, arms or legs, trouble speaking, or a sudden severe headache: call 911.
A fast, very slow or irregular heartbeat: call 911.
Redness, swelling, bleeding, opening, oozing or new drainage at an incision: call your care team today.
Leg swelling is getting worse, especially in the leg where no vein was taken: call your care team today.
A cough that will not go away, or coughing up blood or yellow/green mucus: call your care team today.
Temperature of 100.4°F or higher: call your care team today.
Weight up 2 pounds or more in 24 hours (possible fluid build-up): call your care team today.
Resting pulse above 100: call your care team today.
Resting pulse below 60: call your care team today.
Heavy sweating for no reason: call 911.
Chills: call your care team today.
Sharp chest pain when you take a deep breath: call your care team today.
A clicking or moving feeling in your breastbone: call your care team today.
Trouble taking your heart medicines: call your care team today.
Weight up 5 pounds or more in a week: call your care team today.
